population.about: Ihe na-adịkarị n'etiti ndị yiri onye ọrịa. Onye nyocha nchọpụta ọrịa na-eji nkwupụta na ụkpụrụ ndị a, ndị nyocha nwekwara ike wepụta otu ndị ewepụrụ aha.
population.priorsAbout: Otú ọrịa ọ bụla si dị na-adị maka afọ, nwoke ma ọ bụ nwanyị, mpaghara na oge afọ, site n'isi mmalite e bipụtara na mmelite jikọtara ọnụ.
population.normsAbout: Oke nkịtị nke ihe e tụrụ ọ bụla maka afọ na nwoke ma ọ bụ nwanyị.
population.cohortAbout: Ihe e gụrụ nke onye ọ bụla kwere ka e jiri maka nyocha ma ọ bụ ahụike ọha. Differential privacy na-agbakwunye mkpọtụ ahaziri ma na-eri mmefu nzuzo gị. k-anonymity (izo onye n'otu) na-ezo otu ọ bụla pere mpe karịa k.

system.title: Otu ATRA si arụ ọrụ
system.about: ATRA Health na-ejikọta ejima dijitalụ abụọ maka onye ọ bụla. Ndị nnọchite na-akwado ọrụ ụlọ ọgwụ n'ime ejima ọ bụla, ndị dọkịta e kwuru aha ha na-ekpebikwa mkpebi ọ bụla.

ahdt.name: Ejima Dijitalụ Mmadụ nwere Ndị Nnọchite
ahdt.about: Nke ndụ niile. Ọ nwere data ahụ onye ahụ, ụdị na ọnọdụ site na ejima ndị otu iri na asaa, site n'obi ruo ndụ mmekọrịta. Ọ dị n'agbanyeghị ma onye ahụ na-arịa ọrịa ma ọ bụ na ọ naghị arịa.

apdt.name: Ejima Dijitalụ Onye Ọrịa nwere Ndị Nnọchite
apdt.about: A na-emepe ya mgbe ihe omume nlekọta malitere n'ụlọ ọgwụ ma mechie ya mgbe ọ kwụsịrị. Ọ nwere akụkọ, nyocha ahụ, nnwale, nchọpụta ọrịa, akwụkwọ ọgwụ na mkpebi nke ihe omume ahụ.

system.workflowAbout: Ihe na-eme otu onye ọrịa, nzọụkwụ site na nzọụkwụ.

open.title: Dọkịta na-emepe ihe omume
open.about: Onye ọrụ ahụike, nọọsụ ma ọ bụ onye ọrụ ahụike obodo na-ahọrọ onye ọrịa na ihe kpatara nleta.

intake.title: A na-edekọ ihe ntinye
intake.about: Ihe mgbaàmà, nchọpụta nyocha ahụ, ihe e tụrụ na nsonaazụ nnwale na-aghọ ndekọ FHIR nke ihe omume ahụ.

reason.title: Onye nyocha na-atụ aro
reason.about: Ọ na-ahazi ọrịa ndị ọ nwere ike ịbụ, na-ahọrọ nnwale site n'uru na ọnụ ahịa, na-elele nchekwa ọgwụgwọ, ma na-eme nṅomi ha na ejima onye ọrịa. Ndụmọdụ ọ bụla nwere ngwugwu nkọwa na ihe akaebe na isi mmalite ya.

agents.title: Ndị nnọchite na-akwado mkpebi ọ bụla
agents.about: Ndị ndozi nchọpụta ọrịa, ọgwụgwọ na nlekọta na-anakọta ihe akaebe site n'ejima mmadụ ma kwụsị n'oge mkpebi ọ bụla.

decide.title: Onye ọrụ ahụike na-ekpebi
decide.about: Nabata, dezie ma ọ bụ jụ nchọpụta ọrịa. Bịanye aka n'akwụkwọ ọgwụ. Enweghị ike ibinye aka n'akwụkwọ ọgwụ nwere nsogbu nchekwa na-egbochi ya ruo mgbe e gbanwere ya.

2.about: Ọrụ n'akụkụ n'ụlọ ọgwụ ma ọ bụ n'ụlọ ọ bụla, ụzọ ngwa na ichekwa-tupu-izipu.

3.name: Inweta data
3.about: Nkwado, ịkwado nkeji, izo aha, ebe a na-echekwa data na eserese ihe ọmụma.

4.name: Ụdị
4.about: Ụdị usoro ahụ, ụdị mmụta igwe a zụrụ, na ụdị asụsụ na olu.

5.name: AI nwere ike ịkọwa
5.about: Onye nkọwa maka mmepụta ụdị ọ bụla.

6.name: Ọrụ
6.about: Data, ụdị na nṅomi, nkọwa, ọrụ nghọta na njikọ n'etiti ejima.

7.name: Ndị nnọchite
7.about: Ndị nnọchite ọrụ, ndị ndozi, onye nhazi na API nke mpụga.

8.name: Ngwa
8.about: Ngwa weebụ a, ngwa ekwentị, SMS, USSD na olu.

system.ahdtAgentsAbout: Ndị ọrụ na-arụ otu ọrụ, onye ndozi na-eduzi ejima otu ọ bụla, onye nhazi na-ejikọtakwa ha.
system.apdtAgents: Ndị nnọchite nke ejima onye ọrịa
system.apdtAgentsAbout: Ha na-akwado ọrụ ụlọ ọgwụ. Mkpebi ọ bụla dịkwa n'aka dọkịta e kwuru aha ya.

monitoring.name: Nleba anya
monitoring.about: Ọ na-agụ ọnọdụ ejima na oge e lebara oghere ọ bụla anya ikpeazụ.

anomaly.name: Ihe dị iche
anomaly.about: Ọ na-atụ ka ọnọdụ ejima si dị njọ.

forecasting.name: Amụma
forecasting.about: Ọ na-eme amụma ndị ebumnuche ejima chọrọ.

explanation.name: Nkọwa
explanation.about: Ọ na-akọwa ebumnuche emezughị na mmepụta n'ọkwa nleba anya ma ọ bụ ịdọ aka ná ntị.

recommendation.name: Ndụmọdụ
recommendation.about: Ọ na-atụ aro omume nkwado edepụtara n'ebe nchekwa ihe ọmụma, nke ọ bụla na isi mmalite ya.

orchestrator.name: Onye ndozi ejima
orchestrator.about: Ọ na-ahụ, na-emelite ọnọdụ, na-elele ebumnuche, na-eme atụmatụ, na-arụ ọrụ, na-akọwa ma na-akọ akụkọ maka ejima otu.

conductor.name: Onye nhazi
conductor.about: Ọ na-eme ka ebumnuche nlekọta onye ghọọ obere ebumnuche, na-ahazi ndị ndozi, ma na-edozi esemokwu dị n'etiti atụmatụ ha.

history.name: Ịnara akụkọ
history.about: Ọ na-edepụta ihe ntinye ihe omume ahụ ka chọrọ.

evidence.name: Ịnakọta ihe akaebe
evidence.about: Ọ na-anakọta ihe e gụrụ, ọgwụ, ọnọdụ ejima na nkọwa site n'ejima mmadụ.

differential.name: Nchọpụta ọrịa ndị ọ nwere ike ịbụ
differential.about: Ọ na-ahazi ọrịa ndị ahụ ma na-ewu ngwugwu nkọwa ha.

investigation.name: Nyocha
investigation.about: Ọ na-ahọrọ nnwale ga-agbanwe nchọpụta ọrịa kacha maka ọnụ ahịa ha.

treatment.name: Ịhazi ọgwụgwọ
treatment.about: Ọ na-edepụta nhọrọ ma na-eme nṅomi nke atọ mbụ na ejima onye ọrịa.

pharmacotherapy.name: Ọgwụgwọ site n'ọgwụ
pharmacotherapy.about: Ọ na-elele mmekọrịta ọgwụ, akụrụ, ime na mkpụrụ ndụ ihe nketa maka ọgwụ ọ bụla.

guard.name: Onye nche nchekwa na nkwenye
guard.about: Ọ na-elele omume onye nnọchite ọ bụla tupu o mee.

system.safety: Otu sistemu si ejide ndị dọkịta n'isi
system.safetyAbout: Nyocha abụọ na-adabereghị na ibe ha na-egbochi onye nnọchite ịkpebi okwu ụlọ ọgwụ.

guard.name: Ọkwa nnwere onwe
guard.about: Ụdị omume ọ bụla nwere ọkwa kwesịrị, site na ịma ọkwa ruo mgbe ọ bụla. A naghị ekwe ka onye nnọchite bịanye aka, nye iwu ma ọ bụ kesaa ọgwụ.

human.name: Mmadụ na mkpebi ọ bụla
human.about: API na-anabata mkpebi naanị site n'aka mmadụ nwere ọrụ nzọụkwụ chọrọ, ọ bụghị n'aka onye nnọchite ma ọ bụ ọrụ.

consent.name: Nkwenye
consent.about: Mmadụ nwere ike igbochi ụdị data ọ bụla. Oku ngwaọrụ ọ bụla na-ebu ụzọ lelee nkwenye onye ahụ.

audit.name: Nyocha
audit.about: A na-ede arịrịọ ọ bụla, mkpebi na mjụ na ndekọ nyocha nwere eriri hash.

system.members: Ejima ndị otu iri na asaa
system.membersAbout: Ejima mmadụ bụ njikọta nke ejima ndị a. Nke ọ bụla nwere ụdị ya na ebumnuche ya.
system.modelsAbout: Ụdị ọ bụla nwere ọkwa ntụkwasị obi na-egosi ka e si wuo ya.
system.servicesAbout: Ọrụ ndị dị n'azụ ngwa a na ma nke ọ bụla na-aza ugbu a.
